NONE: › a tool with a long or round blade and a row of sharp points along one edge, used for cutting hard materials such as wood or metal

I or T: › [ I or T ] to cut wood or other hard material using a saw
I + adv/prep: › [ I + adv/prep ] to move something backwards and forwards as if using a saw

example: They sawed the door in half.
He was sawing away at his violin, making a terrible noise!
他在小提琴上拉來拉去，發出難聽的噪音！

NONE: › to make something fall to the ground by cutting it with a saw
› to remove something by cutting it with a saw

example: She sawed off the dead branches of the tree.
她把樹上的枯枝鋸掉了。

NONE: › to cut something into smaller pieces using a saw

example: I'll saw the logs up into smaller pieces.

NONE: › the dust and small pieces of wood that are produced when you cut wood with a saw
› a factory where trees are cut up into pieces with machines
› a shotgun (= a type of gun) with most of the barrel cut off
